title: What #1298 left owed in measuring: no hostname in a measurement file, Google's font files from a disk cache, ROLE-1's follows without what the contract keeps, a kept face as the template's variable, the built-site glyph check reading the page's language
expect: S1: every test passes, including: follows leaves out paints the contract keeps (kept bands, keepWhole, paletteKeep) and counts them apart; the measurement file carries followsSamples and followsKept and the ROLE-1 note names both; /ops judges the role margin as the flow does (apart); a re-measure keeps the preview block; no contract names a face by its name (font-family is var(...) or inherit).

S2: every test passes: a family named only where the release swaps it out for the page's language (a :root:lang(vi) custom property) is no glyph gap on that page and still a gap without the swap; the readiness stamps are read off the tree files.
evidence: Before this change 81 measurement files named the measuring Mac's hostname, 18 templates failed FONT-1 on one take whose font request failed, 32 of 90 files failed ROLE-1 on bands their contracts keep, JA Resort's and JA Symphony's kept faces beat their releases' Vietnamese swap, and the built-site glyph check flagged JA Nova's Golos Text and JA Donate's Glegoo on Vietnamese pages that never draw them
fence: A follows with nothing kept reads every paint as before; a font URL that does not answer still fails in the measuring Chrome; a non-Vietnamese page keeps the same template faces
